blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit the falls with an English-speaking guide.

The trail on the Brazilian side starts in the forest. Individual cascades appear between the trees, before an increasingly wide panorama opens up.

Mist hangs over the forest. As you approach the main section of the falls, the roar grows louder. The route ends at the Devil’s Throat, where the calm flow of the river suddenly becomes a powerful torrent.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, cross the Tancredo Neves Bridge and head to the Argentine section of the national park with an English-speaking guide.

Here, your position in relation to the water changes. Walkways run above the riverbed and at the foot of individual cascades. On the upper trails, the water flows almost calmly beside the walkway before disappearing over the edge. On the lower trails, spray reaches the railings and your face.

Between the walks, you can hear birds and see coatis in the forest, while the roar of the falls recedes and then fills the air again.

After the tour, transfer to the airport and fly to Buenos Aires. On arrival, meet your driver and transfer to the hotel.

The evening is free.
